population.span: The CANVAS Program (Canagliflozin Cardiovascular Assessment Study) enrolled 10 142 participants with type 2 diabetes mellitus and high cardiovascular risk.

endpoint.span: as well as hospitalized HF alone (HR, 0.67; 95% CI, 0.52–0.87).

estimate.span: as well as hospitalized HF alone (HR, 0.67; 95% CI, 0.52–0.87).

ci.span: as well as hospitalized HF alone (HR, 0.67; 95% CI, 0.52–0.87).

analysis_set.span: Efficacy analyses were based on the full integrated dataset and the intent-to-treat approach, with the comparison being between all participants assigned to canagliflozin (regardless of dose) and all participants assigned to placebo.

treatment_strategy.span: Participants in CANVAS were assigned in a 1:1:1 ratio to canagliflozin 300 mg, canagliflozin 100 mg, or matching placebo, and participants in CANVAS-R were randomly assigned in a 1:1 ratio to canagliflozin or matching placebo, administered at an initial dose of 100 mg daily with optional uptitration to 300 mg from week 13.

follow_up.span: There were 10 142 patients with type 2 diabetes mellitus in the CANVAS Program, and the mean follow-up time was 188.2 weeks.

entry_population_matches_question.why: The program enrolled adults with type 2 diabetes and high cardiovascular risk, including participants with and without baseline heart failure.
entry_population_matches_question.span: In addition, 1461 (14.4%) participants reported a history of HF at baseline.

notes: All fields are bound to the held CANVAS Program heart-failure report, PMID 29526832. The estimate concerns hospitalized HF alone in the integrated intention-to-treat population; it matches the served numbers. Follow-up is the reported mean duration.
